nonclaims: Structural mapping does not establish requirements completeness.
The ATDD donor has stale internal provenance and remains a research-only draft.
The Luna donor has stale internal provenance and remains advisory only.
No row is evidence of specification completion, implementation, proof, mounting, testing, release eligibility, or production authority.
This registry grants no value-moving, settlement, publication, migration, or promotion authority.
The JSON and Markdown outputs are independently atomic files; a crash can leave a mixed pair until deterministic regeneration reruns.

source_fields.law: Every managed asset has one versioned issue policy and one versioned burn policy; protocol-specific burns remain legal only through their named transition, while generic production mint, burn, and faucet paths reject.
source_fields.name: managed_asset_single_issuer

source_fields.law: zUSD debt equals external supply plus every current internal zUSD liability, including fee and Stability Pool ownership projections.
source_fields.name: zusd_liability_cover

source_fields.law: Every accepted transition has an exact per-asset, per-custody delta certificate with no unnamed remainder.
source_fields.name: per_asset_conservation

source_fields.law: Every custody balance equals the complete set of current claims or an explicitly owned reserve bucket.
source_fields.name: custody_and_claim_reconciliation

source_fields.law: Admission or publication rejection publishes no successor, nonce, receipt, balance patch, effect, or outbox row. An authenticated, well-formed command admitted to a canonical batch whose business transition rejects publishes a committed failure candidate that advances only ingress nonce, history, nullifier, receipt, publication identity, and head; it leaves all economic atoms, escrow, withdrawal, acknowledgment, external balance patches, effects, and outbox rows unchanged.
source_fields.name: rejection_partition

source_fields.law: Equal canonical state, command, authenticated context, and active pinned profile produce byte-identical decision, state, effects, and receipt; Tau Net reachability is not an input to the transition.
source_fields.name: deterministic_canonical_transition

source_fields.law: One authenticated sender nonce or nullifier can authorize at most one committed transition.
source_fields.name: replay_uniqueness

source_fields.law: Every authorization and proof binds the exact current state, deployment, authority epoch, verifier profile, and freshness context.
source_fields.name: current_context_binding

source_fields.law: State, history, nullifier, decision, receipt, economic certificate, authority epoch, and required outbox rows publish at one linearization point.
source_fields.name: atomic_publication

source_fields.law: Every external semantic effect descends from one committed effect identity; redelivery cannot change its meaning.
source_fields.name: external_effect_ancestry

source_fields.law: Recovery reconstructs exact PRE or exact POST or rejects, and reopen alone grants no writer authority.
source_fields.name: reopen_pre_or_post_and_reauthorize

source_fields.law: Every reachable value-moving entrypoint reaches the unique publication capability or rejects.
source_fields.name: mounted_no_bypass

source_fields.law: Risk-increasing commands require current authenticated prices; stale or deficit states admit only the declared recovery subset.
source_fields.name: oracle_conditional_risk_safety

source_fields.law: Every enabled terminal lifecycle has a complete, deterministic claim and custody drain with no stranded liability.
source_fields.name: terminal_state_drains_exactly

minimum_acceptance: A native custody snapshot binds chain, deployment, head, height, canonical accounts, and source receipt.
Sequential transitions consume the committed post-snapshot rather than reusing the block pre-snapshot.
The native patch and internal native delta publish at one linearization point.
Altered, stale, foreign, duplicate-account, and noncanonical snapshots reject without mutation.
source_fields.title: native custody snapshot and patch mediation

minimum_acceptance: Unknown streams and duplicate semantic variants reject.
Current and legacy aliases cannot coexist unless exact equivalence is proved.
Faucet, unsigned-intent, permissive-settlement, and isolated-perps flags belong to a root-bound test-only profile that production rejects.
source_fields.title: closed operation language and profile isolation

minimum_acceptance: Every asset source, sink, custody bucket, claim, reserve, reward, fee, margin, PnL, and residue appears in one typed delta certificate.
Native collateral, Stability Pool collateral, protocol collateral, reward custody, DEX pools, LP supply, and perps liabilities are reconciled alongside zUSD.
Zero, one, max-minus-one, max, overflow, rounding, and dust boundaries are executable.
source_fields.title: complete economic state and delta certificate

minimum_acceptance: stake_fee_shares, activate_fee_stake, unstake_fee_shares, claim_protocol_fees, claim_host_fees, claim_staking_fees, and claim_fee_rewards are explicit workflows.
Every current fee owner, reserve, reward debt, residue, and terminal drain reconciles exactly.
source_fields.title: fee staking and fee-owner lifecycle

minimum_acceptance: The mounted command language explicitly supports or excludes owner close and multi-vault redemption.
Full-close surplus, ordering, fees, collateral, debt, and terminal state are atomically bound.
source_fields.title: zUSD exact close and multi-vault redemption

minimum_acceptance: Market parameter changes, partial liquidation, insurance deposits, funding application, carried liabilities, and recovery settlements have explicit value and authority contracts.
zUSD and perps share one authenticated world-price context or reject divergence.

semantic_anchors.accounting_language: Key control determines practical custody. Same-ledger values are described by accounting location, accounting control domain, claimant entitlement, and key authority.
semantic_anchors.asset_precision: Eight decimal places represented as unsigned integer atoms. Floats are forbidden in authoritative paths.
semantic_anchors.autonomous_governance: Autonomous governance and LLM agents may submit authenticated typed commands. They have no publication capability.
semantic_anchors.buy_and_burn: Spend the governed quote-asset fee allocation through the release-selected Spot route and burn the exact ZDEX atoms received.
semantic_anchors.external_lane: The registered external lane starts empty. Unregistered destinations reject without mutation.
semantic_anchors.hosting_compensation: A separately named governed fee allocation with explicit eligibility, claimant, expiry, cancellation, and terminal-drain semantics.
semantic_anchors.hyperdeflation: No fixed percentage of initial supply is required as a floor. Each burn obeys a profile-bound retained-supply rule and cannot exceed current supply minus retained supply.
semantic_anchors.rescaling: No denomination rescaling under GlobalSettlementABI V1.
semantic_anchors.tau_role: Current Tau may authenticate and tentatively order Tau transactions and may evaluate governed policy predicates. A versioned adapter must separately authenticate a domain-bound EconomicCommandOccurrenceV1. ZenoLedger ordering and publication remain authoritative.

source_fields.law: Every managed asset has one versioned issue policy and one versioned burn policy; protocol-specific burns remain legal only through their named transition, while generic production mint, burn, and faucet paths reject.
source_fields.name: managed_asset_single_issuer

source_fields.law: zUSD debt equals external supply plus every current internal zUSD liability, including fee and Stability Pool ownership projections.
source_fields.name: zusd_liability_cover

source_fields.law: Every accepted transition has an exact per-asset, per-custody delta certificate with no unnamed remainder.
source_fields.name: per_asset_conservation

source_fields.law: Every custody balance equals the complete set of current claims or an explicitly owned reserve bucket.
source_fields.name: custody_and_claim_reconciliation

source_fields.law: Admission or publication rejection publishes no successor, nonce, receipt, balance patch, effect, or outbox row. An authenticated, well-formed command admitted to a canonical batch whose business transition rejects publishes a committed failure candidate that advances only ingress nonce, history, nullifier, receipt, publication identity, and head; it leaves all economic atoms, escrow, withdrawal, acknowledgment, external balance patches, effects, and outbox rows unchanged.
source_fields.name: rejection_partition

source_fields.law: Equal canonical state, command, authenticated context, and active pinned profile produce byte-identical decision, state, effects, and receipt; Tau Net reachability is not an input to the transition.
source_fields.name: deterministic_canonical_transition

source_fields.law: One authenticated sender nonce or nullifier can authorize at most one committed transition.
source_fields.name: replay_uniqueness

source_fields.law: Every authorization and proof binds the exact current state, deployment, authority epoch, verifier profile, and freshness context.
source_fields.name: current_context_binding

source_fields.law: State, history, nullifier, decision, receipt, economic certificate, authority epoch, and required outbox rows publish at one linearization point.
source_fields.name: atomic_publication

source_fields.law: Every external semantic effect descends from one committed effect identity; redelivery cannot change its meaning.
source_fields.name: external_effect_ancestry

source_fields.law: Recovery reconstructs exact PRE or exact POST or rejects, and reopen alone grants no writer authority.
source_fields.name: reopen_pre_or_post_and_reauthorize

source_fields.law: Every reachable value-moving entrypoint reaches the unique publication capability or rejects.
source_fields.name: mounted_no_bypass

source_fields.law: Risk-increasing commands require current authenticated prices; stale or deficit states admit only the declared recovery subset.
source_fields.name: oracle_conditional_risk_safety

source_fields.law: Every enabled terminal lifecycle has a complete, deterministic claim and custody drain with no stranded liability.
source_fields.name: terminal_state_drains_exactly
